working_title: He Lived 60 Hours at the Bottom of the Sea
alt_title: The Cook Who Breathed in a Sunken Ship
subject: Harrison Okene, cook on the tug Jascon-4, capsized off Nigeria on 26 May 2013. He survived ~60 h in an air pocket (~4 ft high) at ~30 m until DCN divers, sent to recover bodies, found him on 28 May. He then spent ~60 h in decompression. 11 crew died.
why_potential: It has a single impossible number (60 hours), a shrinking-air clock, and a twist (the divers were recovering bodies). The air-pocket physics suits animation. The real rescue footage went viral globally in Dec 2013, so recognition is proven. It is evergreen survival content.

working_title: 30 Minutes With No Air, 100 m Down
alt_title: The Diver Who Should Be Dead
subject: Chris Lemons, saturation diver on DSV Bibby Topaz, North Sea, 18 Sep 2012. A dynamic-positioning failure severed his umbilical at ~90-100 m. He had ~5-10 min of bailout gas, was found unresponsive and revived in the bell by Duncan Allcock with Dave Yuasa. Reported times without main supply vary from ~20 to ~40 min. Documentary Last Breath (2019); feature film (2025).
why_potential: An impossible-survival anchor plus a medical mystery (cold and high-O2 bailout are reported hypotheses). Thoughty2 1.2M; the trailer reportedly 7.8M; a 2025 film keeps it topical.

working_title: Why Is There a Statue of Jesus 17 m Underwater?
alt_title: Christ of the Abyss
subject: Il Cristo degli Abissi, a bronze statue by Guido Galletti placed in 1954 in San Fruttuoso bay (Italy) at ~17 m, in memory of diver Dario Gonzatti (died 1947) and associated with diving pioneer Duilio Marcante. Copies exist elsewhere (e.g., Key Largo, Grenada).
why_potential: A strange-image curiosity gap with a heartfelt memorial answer. Low demand and low stakes, but very feasible and calm. Useful as a gentle, loopable Short.
hook_15s: 0-2 s: Diver light reveals bronze arms raised toward the surface. VO: 'There's a statue of Jesus 17 metres under the sea.' | 2-6 s: 'Italy, 1954'. | 6-15 s: VO: 'It was put there for one diver.'
thumbnail_concept: Bronze figure arms raised in sun shafts, small diver, '17 m DOWN'.
animation_style: Sun-shaft caustics, bronze shader with coral growth, gentle palette.
verification_status: NEEDS FACT-CHECK (not verified this session): depth, dates, the Gonzatti dedication, sculptor.
